subject: Security & compliance: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA follow-up and roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finco.com>, Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@finco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA & next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of what you asked about:
- SOC 2 status and scope (which workloads and deployments are covered)
- GDPR data residency and data processing agreements
- HIPAA / BAA requirements for PHI use cases
- Vendor security questionnaire: you mentioned you have an XLS to share

What Redwood shared on the call (high-level):
- SOC 2: Redwood currently holds a SOC 2 Type II report that covers our hosted API/control plane (report issued 2025-11-01).
- Scope expansion: we are actively expanding SOC scope to include Dedicated and Private deployments; target for audit completion is Q3 2027 (we expect to provide interim evidence earlier).
- GDPR: We support data export controls and region routing; we publish our DPA and standard contractual clauses where relevant.
- HIPAA: We offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments today; evaluating hosted BAA options and can escalate if required for your use case.

Proposed next steps (feel free to adjust):
1) Samantha/Tom: send over your vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned an XLS).
2) Redwood (me): share a redacted SOC 2 report and our security overview + DPA.
3) Internal: loop in Rishi (security) and Lauren (solutions) to own technical Q&A and timeline.
4) Schedule a follow-up call next week to walk through the questionnaire and agree on evidence/owners.

Attachments: I’ll upload the SOC 2 redacted PDF once I have confirmation on the questionnaire items you need redacted.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Attaching our vendor questionnaire (procurement XLS) for your team to complete. A few clarifications up front: 

- We need confirmation of encryption at rest for customer data and key management approach (KMS/HSM).
- Please confirm whether SOC 2 report covers encryption and access controls, and whether the scope includes Dedicated/Private.
- HIPAA: for clinical workflows we'd need a signed BAA and confirmation that the environment you plan to host the workload in is in scope of the BAA.
- Data residency: we prefer EU region routing for EU customer data; need confirmation of region options and where logs/audit trails are stored.

Can you have someone from security fill out the XLS? Ideally before our follow-up call next week.

Attachment: FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire_20270330.xlsx (procurement)

Thanks,
Samantha Green
CISO, FinCo
Samantha.Green@finco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finco.com>, Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA & next steps

Rishi / Lauren — forwarding FinCo’s questionnaire and the call notes. They want us to answer the vendor XLS ahead of the follow-up next week. Can you help with the following ownerships?

Rishi: can you confirm (and provide short answers for the XLS) on:
- Current SOC 2 coverage (control list and date of last audit)
- Encryption at rest (KMS/HSM details) and key rotation policy
- BAA availability and which deployment types are covered today
- Evidence items we can provide quickly (config screenshots, policy excerpts, pen test summary)

Lauren: can you capture the deployment/ops answers for Dedicated/Private (region routing, log retention locations, MSP contacts) and help coordinate a short demo if they want to validate isolation controls.

Samantha / Tom: we’ll aim to return a completed questionnaire (with attachments) by Thu EOD PT. If any answers require legal redlines (BAA) we’ll flag for a short review.

Attaching: FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire_20270330.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 13:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA & next steps

Marissa / Lauren / Samantha — quick notes from security: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (issued 2025-11-01) that currently covers the Redwood hosted API/control plane and associated production infra. We are mid-program to expand the scope to Dedicated and Private (audit window targeted Q3 2027).
- Encryption: Customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 with customer keys stored in AWS KMS; for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM. Key rotation policies and KMS config excerpts can be provided.
- BAA: BAAs are available today for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API BAA options are being evaluated; we can provide a temporary controls attestation while legal finalizes hosted BAA language if needed.
- GDPR: We provide region routing for EU data and are able to sign DPAs including SCCs. Logs/audit trails for hosted route to us-east-1 by default; for EU-region routing logs can be kept within eu-west-1 upon request (subject to configuration).
- Evidence pack: I can provide a redacted SOC 2 report, pen test summary, architecture diagram, and KMS config snippets. I recommend we redact account-specific identifiers before sending.

Action items / owners: 
- Rishi: fill questionnaire answers + upload redacted SOC 2 and pen test summary by Thu EOD PT.
- Lauren: confirm Dedicated/Private region options and provide ops screenshots for the questionnaire.
- Marissa: coordinate delivery and follow-up call scheduling.

I’ll prepare a short answers doc and the redacted SOC 2 now; will upload to the Drive link and share once ready.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Security | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@finco.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap — SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA & next steps

Thanks everyone — that schedule works. We’ll expect the completed questionnaire and redacted SOC 2 by Thu EOD PT.

Can we schedule 30 minutes on Friday to go through any open items and confirm timeframe for a BAA (if required)? I’m available Fri 10:00–12:00 PT.

Samantha
